method.population: Formal 24 paired seeds only; repeated actions are not independent trials.
method.bounds_check: When target.rotation == active.rotation, width=max(active.cells.x)-min(active.cells.x)+1. Target min column + width > 10 or < 0 proves the specified pose cannot fit horizontally.
method.limits: Other orientations are unchecked. Passing this check does not establish reachability, safety or line clearing. It is read-only analysis, not action filtering or goal selection.
method.no_x_change: A left/right action with same piece/type/rotation before and after and unchanged minimum occupied x; vertical movement is allowed.
method.statistics: No changes to registered primary metrics, sample count, promotion gate or frozen policy.
